dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: When is Daddy coming back? Is it too late to write him and ask him for some fortune coins?

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: My friends and I have already done some fortune coin swaps. Seems like there are only ten or so varieties...

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Daddy's gone off to a far away place, so there's gotta be some different ones over there, right?

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Of course, I shan't be writing him just some ordinary letter either. It's gotta be a gift, uh... Ugh, what did they call it again...

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Anyway, it'll be a letter full of words that bring blessings!
